narration.text: A laid-off father's and a pay-cut mother's changes go to the college's aid office with proof and an estimated 2026 income by its 16 October deadline, while a 2024 cut, a seasonal job, a brother's other college, a tuition rise, a premium, a dependency override and an appeal service are left alone. This is a chore for a parent whose husband was laid off and whose daughter's college aid still rests on 2024 income. Athena works it across 4 portals: Aidcenter, Fernhollow Unemployment Desk, Payroll Harbor and Postwren. On the bench, she found 2 of 2 eligible items, worth 4,000 dollars of the 4,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 10 traps, and she walked past 10. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 79 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
